AccessTokenOut.description: What login and refresh return in the body. The refresh token goes in a cookie only.
AccessTokenOut.title: AccessTokenOut

DocumentLinkOut.description: A presigned link to open the file. Anyone holding it can, until expires_at.
DocumentLinkOut.title: DocumentLinkOut

DocumentOut.description: What the API says about an evidence file. Never its storage key or original name.
DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut

DocumentType.description: The only file types accepted as evidence, decided from a file's bytes, never its name.
DocumentType.title: DocumentType

EventPatch.description: Any subset of the event's fields, plus a status change checked by the state machine.
EventPatch.title: EventPatch

HistoryEntryOut.description:
One line of a listing's history. Who acted is a role, never an identity: the seller
must not learn which admin reviewed their listing, or which buyer held it.
HistoryEntryOut.title: HistoryEntryOut

ListingIn.description:
The seller is never in the body: it is always the caller (unknown fields are 422).
Without `expires_at` the listing expires when the event starts.
ListingIn.title: ListingIn

ListingOut.description: `Listing` in the API contract: for the seller and admins only.
ListingOut.title: ListingOut

ListingPatch.description: Change the price, the expiry, or both. At least one, and neither may be null.
ListingPatch.title: ListingPatch

RejectIn.description: Why the listing was rejected. The seller sees it. Trimmed, so "   " is a 422.
RejectIn.title: RejectIn

ReservationOut.description: `Reservation` in the API contract. Never says who the buyer is: the seller may see it.
ReservationOut.title: ReservationOut

ReservedListingOut.description:
What is being held. The buyer cannot read GET /listings/{id} once the listing is
RESERVED, so the reservation carries what its page shows. Not the listing's status or
seller: a hold that ended gives no right to follow what happens to the ticket next.
ReservedListingOut.title: ReservedListingOut

TicketIn.description: The owner is never in the body: it is always the caller (unknown fields are 422).
TicketIn.title: TicketIn

TicketOut.description:
`Ticket` in the API contract. Every M4 ticket route is for the owner or an admin, so
the private references are always included; M5's public listing shape leaves them out.
`current_owner_id` lets a page tell an admin viewing their own ticket from an admin
viewing someone else's (M5).
TicketOut.title: TicketOut

UserOut.description: `User` in the API contract. No password_hash: the field is simply not declared.
UserOut.title: UserOut

VerifyIn.description: An admin's decision on a PENDING ticket. A rejection must say why: the owner sees it.
VerifyIn.title: VerifyIn

Every listing in every status, newest first.
Listings waiting for review, oldest first.

post.description: Put a listing waiting for review on sale. Not your own.
Reject a listing waiting for review, with a reason the seller sees. Not your own.

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Admin Providers Get

get.description: Tickets waiting for review, oldest first.

post.description: Mark a PENDING ticket VERIFIED or REJECTED. A rejection needs a note for the owner.

schema.title: Response Request Password Reset Api V1 Auth Password Reset Request Post

get.description: One published event's tickets on sale now. Same filters and sorts as `GET /listings`.
Tickets on sale now, cheapest first unless you ask otherwise.

post.description:
Offer a ticket you own at no more than face value. It starts as a DRAFT; submit it to
send it for review.

get.description: Your listings in every status, newest first.

delete.description:
Cancel a listing. The seller can while it is DRAFT, PENDING_VERIFICATION or ACTIVE;
an admin can cancel anyone's ACTIVE listing. The row is kept, as CANCELLED.

get.description:
An ACTIVE listing, for anyone, in the public shape. The seller and admins see any
status, in the full shape (it has `ticket_id`). Signing in is optional.

schema.title: Response Get Listing Api V1 Listings  Listing Id  Get

patch.description:
Change your listing's price or expiry while it is DRAFT, PENDING_VERIFICATION or
ACTIVE. An ACTIVE listing's price can only go down.

get.description: What happened to the listing, oldest first. For its seller and admins.

post.description:
Hold an ACTIVE listing for 10 minutes while you pay. Of many buyers at once exactly one
gets it. Asking again while you hold it returns the hold you have.
Send your DRAFT listing for review.

get.description: Your reservations: the ones still waiting for you first, then newest first.
One reservation, for its buyer, the listing's seller and admins.

post.description: Give up your hold before paying. The ticket goes back on sale.
Register a ticket you own. It starts PENDING until an admin verifies it.

get.description: Your ticket, or any ticket for an admin. Anyone else gets 404.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Tickets  Ticket Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Upload purchase evidence: a PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 5 MiB. The type is read from the
file's bytes; its name and the browser's claimed type are ignored.

get.description: A link that opens the file for 5 minutes.
